title: The Lineage
subtitle: inheritance as witness
mapEpigraph: The line did not end before you.

prompts.text: Who in your lineage do you admire?
What did they create, protect, or stand for?
What quality feels inherited as a gift rather than an obligation?
What part of their courage lives in me?

blocks.title: The line behind you
blocks.instruction: Stand or sit with a sense of the line behind you. Speak one ancestor's name, or name an unknown figure by their quality: “the builder,” “the one who crossed,” “the caretaker.”
